# Powering the Conversation: Inside GenDrive Manufacturing with Jose Luis Crespo, CEO


August 24, 2026


Plug CEO Jose Luis Crespo takes you inside the Company’s headquarters in Slingerlands, New York, for a closer look at Plug’s GenDrive fuel cell manufacturing operations. Walking through the production line, Jose Luis highlights Plug’s manufacturing capabilities, production capacity, and the scale and experience behind the technology powering material handling operations around the world
